fusions.name: Returned Throw
fusions.desc: Hurls a spear for 8 damage, up to 2 times as much at its maximum range. You hold up to 4 charges, and each kill returns one.

fusions.name: Pointing Charge
fusions.desc: Rushes 6 tiles at the target, dealing 16 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It is knocked back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Long Reach
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further. A hound escort fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Nose Down
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your next strike gains 15% critical hit chance. Once every 6 seconds.
